verdict.rationale: Exa documents per-key controls: you can review usage and set a lower limit on an individual API key (exa-docs-42). It also publishes a Team Management API spec that implies key management (exa-docs-38). This lets a separate key handed to an agent be capped, but it limits usage volume rather than scoping what the key may access. Missing for 10: permission/endpoint scoping per key, documented least-privilege or read-only key roles, per-key expiry/revocation docs, and independent corroboration.
